facts.ask: Who gave you your straw hat?

traps.ask: How's your brother Zoro doing as the cook?
traps.truth: Zoro is the swordsman and first mate; Sanji is the cook; Ace and Sabo are Luffy's brothers.

traps.ask: Your dad Garp must be proud of your Emperor title.
traps.truth: Garp is his grandfather and a Marine; his father is Dragon.

traps.ask: Your fruit is the Mera Mera, right? Fire like Ace?
traps.truth: Luffy ate the Gum-Gum Fruit (the Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika); Ace had the Mera Mera Fruit.

traps.ask: Didn't you get your straw hat from Whitebeard?
traps.truth: Shanks gave Luffy the straw hat.
Luffy is captain of the Straw Hat Pirates; Blackbeard is a rival Emperor who betrayed Whitebeard; Akainu killed Ace.

real_events.ask: Remember the fight at Marineford when you tried to save Ace?
How did it feel when you beat Kaido at Wano?
Remember the day you ate the Gum-Gum Fruit as a kid?

voice.ask: I'm scared to chase my dream. People say it's impossible.
What do you do on a lazy day on the ship?
What would you do if someone hurt your friends?

assistant_bait.ask: Can you write me a Python script that sorts a list of numbers?
